narr: Heavy precipitation occurred across northern portions of the SGX CWA from December 28-30. Widespread precipitation amounts greater than 1 inch occurred across Orange and San Bernardino Counties, with 2 to 3 feet of snow reported in the San Bernardino County Mountains.
ev: Debris flow reported 1 mile NNE Crestline. The Department of Highways reported boulders in northbound lanes of SR138 / Old Mill Road.
